primary.prompt: A Python app needs Foundry project properties, agents, evaluations, and Foundry-specific platform features. Choose the current route.
A team is writing a hosted agent with custom orchestration and expects the code to use the Responses API while running in its own process during development. Choose the current route.
An app needs embeddings and prioritizes maximum OpenAI API compatibility and low latency. Choose the current route.
An authorized project must call an Anthropic Claude model deployed in Foundry. Choose the current route.
A lightweight application needs the current prebuilt Speech service client rather than a general model or agent client. Choose the current route.
A learner has only an Azure OpenAI resource and assumes it exposes every Foundry project, agent, tool, and Anthropic endpoint. Choose the safest next decision.
A sample uses DefaultAzureCredential, but the learner has not verified the approved identity, RBAC, resource, or scope. Choose the safest next decision.
A six-month-old note names a package version and endpoint, while the live lab begins tomorrow. Choose the safest next decision.

transfer.prompt: A client must list project connections and then use Foundry-native evaluation features through one project boundary. Choose the current route.
A developer needs a code-based multi-agent system with custom orchestration that can later be packaged as a hosted agent. Choose the current route.
A direct-model app needs Chat Completions and the broad OpenAI API surface rather than Foundry-specific project operations. Choose the current route.
A project requirement explicitly selects Claude and the team needs the provider-specific endpoint route described by Microsoft. Choose the current route.
An app uses a prebuilt Language client for text analysis and does not need agent orchestration. Choose the current route.
A copied snippet targets a Foundry project endpoint, but the authorized resource type has not been confirmed. Choose the safest next decision.
A correct SDK route is known, but no one has confirmed subscription access or a least-privilege role. Choose the safest next decision.
A practice answer depends on a current role name, preview label, and model availability. Choose the safest next decision before live use.
